content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DoT Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DoT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.dot.gov.in/ Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DoT recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Department of Telecommunications recruitment is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by DoT?
faq.answer: The Department of Telecommunications has announced a total of 31 vacancies for various posts including Stenographer Grade-I, Sr. Accountant, Junior Accountant, Stenographer Grade-II, and LDC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these DoT posts?
faq.answer: The application process for these DoT posts is strictly offline. Candidates need to send their duly filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for the DoT recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligibility is restricted to officials from Central Government, State Government, Union Territories, Autonomous Bodies, and Public Sector Undertakings who meet the specified criteria.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this recruitment drive is up to 56 years. Age relaxation details, if any, should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What are the different posts available in this DoT recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Stenographer Grade-I, Senior Accountant, Junior Accountant, Stenographer Grade-II, and Lower Division Clerk (LDC).

faq.question: Q7. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification mentioned is 12th pass. However, specific qualifications for each post may vary and should be verified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary is offered at different levels: Level-6 for Stenographer Grade-I and Sr. Accountant, Level-5 for Junior Accountant, Level-4 for Stenographer Grade-II, and Level-2 for LDC.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Department of Telecommunications, which is www.cgca.gov.in/ccamh.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this DoT recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted on a deputation basis, meaning eligible government officials can apply to be posted in the Department of Telecommunications.
